rules.name: duplicate-definition
rules.description: An ID is defined more than once.

rules.name: dangling-reference
rules.description: An ID is referenced but defined nowhere.

rules.name: definition-outside-home
rules.description: An ID is defined outside the files its kind allows (ids.json home).

rules.name: broken-evidence
rules.description: An evidence link names a file that does not exist under legacy/, or a line range outside it.

rules.name: missing-evidence
rules.description: A business rule has no evidence link in its section.

rules.name: untraced-requirement
rules.description: A functional requirement references no business rule and has no evidence link.

rules.name: uncovered-requirement
rules.description: No test scenario references the requirement.

rules.name: unmitigated-risk
rules.description: A risk row has an empty Mitigation cell.

rules.name: open-conflict
rules.description: A baseline conflict is still open.

rules.name: invalid-adr-status
rules.description: An ADR has no **Status:** line, or its value is not an allowed status.

rules.name: invalid-front-matter
rules.description: A deliverable file has missing or invalid front-matter (front-matter.schema.json), or its id does not match deliverables.json.

rules.name: malformed-id
rules.description: Text looks like an ID of a known kind but does not match its pattern, for example FR-12 or NFR-FOO-001.

rules.name: missing-deliverable
rules.description: A file that deliverables.json lists does not exist.
